Analytic continuation and the functional equation are imported from elliptic-curve modularity.

euler_product.bad_factor_policy: At the semistable bad prime 389, the classical reciprocal factor is 1-(1)T; the local-Euler moment detector explicitly omits this prime.
euler_product.coverage: Every good rational prime p<=prime_bound is independently point-counted from the imported model.
euler_product.reciprocal_coefficient_definition: mu_E(p)=-a_p and mu_E(p^2)=p in the classical variable at good p
